title: NFTMigrator.migrate() is O(v1.nextIndex()) and may hit block gas limit at scale
description: Users pay gas proportional to total number of V1 dispatchers, regardless of how many they hold. Long-term scaling risk.
impact: Scaling/UX concern — gas cost grows linearly with dispatcher count. At sufficient scale migrate() may exceed block gas limit, blocking migrations.
attack_path: Owner registers many V1 dispatchers over time.
Users invoking migrate() pay gas for iterating every index.
At sufficient scale, gas cost exceeds block limit, blocking migrations.
recommendation: Add a per-index migrate overload: `migrate(uint256 v1Index)`.
